entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: A necropolis of the Returned on Theros, in the Despair Lands.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Undead mortals who escaped the Underworld and lost memories and faces, hiding them behind golden masks.

entities.name: Order of Phaios
entities.description: Cabal of evil mages defending Asphodel with blood magic.

entities.name: Aphonai
entities.description: Three silent Returned who rule Asphodel.

entities.name: Coliseum of the Aphonai
entities.description: Asphodel's seat of government where trespassers are judged.

entities.name: Stoa of Shadows
entities.description: Hall where the Order of Phaios records secrets.

entities.name: Blood Tree
entities.description: Crimson cypress at the Mire's southern point.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God of Passage with a shrine near the Blood Tree.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Lost his mother Lidia through the shrine's Underworld entrance.

entities.name: Aphemia
entities.description: Nyxborn harpy who controls the Returned with her song.

events.summary: Aphemia prowls the Despair Lands, using her song to command the Returned in raids on Meletian and Setessan settlements.
events.quote: using her unique song to control the Returned and command them to partake in raids on Meletian and Setessan settlements.

relations.quote: Asphodel is ruled by three silent Returned called the Aphonai .
Asphodel is defended by a cabal of evil mages
She was used as a minion of Ashiok .
